Maya: Quick 3-question poll for Friday! Reply with numbers (e.g., 1A/2C/3B). Closing at 11:30.
1) Best editor: A) VSCode  B) NeoVim  C) JetBrains  D) Emacs
2) Favorite model codename: A) RedwoodFox  B) TitanOak  C) CobaltPanda  D) EmberRaven
3) Lunch — tacos or grain bowls? A) Tacos  B) Bowls

Noah: 1A/2C/3A — VSCode, CobaltPanda, tacos :taco:

Priya: 1B/2A/3B — NeoVim + RedwoodFox + bowl. spicy.

Liam: 1A/2D/3A — VSCode, EmberRaven, tacos. also +1 for extra guac

Zoe: 1C/2B/3B — JetBrains, TitanOak, bowls

Ethan: 1D/2C/3A — Emacs for life, CobaltPanda, tacos :heart:

Sofia: 1A/2A/3B — VSCode + RedwoodFox + bowls. (I negotiate desk swap)

Maya: Quick tally so far: editors -> VSCode 4, NeoVim 1, JetBrains 1, Emacs 1.
Codenames -> RedwoodFox 2, CobaltPanda 2, TitanOak 1, EmberRaven 1.
Food -> Tacos 3, Bowls 3. Close!

Noah: wait, does deploy-bot count votes? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Reminder: Lunch order cutoff is 11:40. Place orders in #lunch-orders. :robot_face:

Priya: tie-breaker time? I'll swing to 2A -> RedwoodFox to break the codename tie.

Liam: 2A noted. final counts please? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Maya: Final: editors — VSCode 4, NeoVim 1, JetBrains 1, Emacs 1.
Codenames — RedwoodFox 3, CobaltPanda 2, TitanOak 1, EmberRaven 1.
Lunch — Bowls 4, Tacos 3. Bowls win. Ordering now.

Noah: Bowls it is. thanks!

Maya: Ordering placed. Enjoy lunch everyone :bento:
